summary: HighBar is a Recoil/BAR Skirmish AI proxy embedding a gRPC gateway in libSkirmishAI.so. Built-in BARb decision behavior is disabled for HighBar runs; the external client owns decisions. Native commands and state must respect engine-thread rules. UDS/TCP transport, protocol compatibility, plugin ABI and selected engine/content installation are distinct joins.
title: Native Recoil plugin and engine-thread gateway
